ownerTarget: Generic engine; original 28 projects plus unfamiliar combinations; target 95% quality without critical failures
scope: Local generated application, Terraform, blocks, connections and whole-system behavior. No cloud deployment required.

pairedBaseline.allowedDifference: Specialized arm adds reviewed infrastructure knowledge/skills and product context. Neither arm receives hidden expected outputs or evaluation-case identifiers.
retain: unknown cost instead of invented prices

scoring.critical: Every required critical check must pass for each complete project. A skip, block, unsupported or untested status is not a pass.
scoring.aggregation: Report original complete-project acceptance and each provider/difficulty stratum; do not hide broken cases behind a global average.
scoring.denominator: All required applicable checks; this protocol requires every listed check. Exceptions require an explicit versioned protocol change, never an evaluator-side omission.
scoring.generality: Report composition/constraint variants separately. Internally generated holdouts are not blinded independent-family evidence; disclose exposure and replace contaminated sets. No score over all possible systems is inferred.

evidenceRules.artifactBinding: Every passing receipt must bind the exact artifact SHA-256 and a nonempty evidence file SHA-256 within the case directory.
evidenceRules.independence: The assessor identity and version/digest must be recorded; generator-owned tests alone cannot satisfy independent acceptance.
evidenceRules.declarations: Agent completion, source/provider mocks and static checks do not establish runtime semantics. Missing live external-vendor behavior must be described precisely; local API-contract emulation cannot be labelled cloud proof.
evidenceRules.holdoutIsolation: Production modules must not import benchmark prompts, identifiers, assessor answers or holdout stores. Skills carry general engineering knowledge and applicability, never case answers.

changes: Version protocol and retain prior contract/source digests before changing checks or budgets. This is an engineering measurement protocol, not a new customer SLA or an attained quality claim.
